digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP tool loading and deferral
propositions: Serena's symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction asymmetry versus always-loaded tools like Bash

ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is a global all-or-nothing lever (no per-tool or per-server control); setting it to 'false' loads all MCP server schemas upfront at a measured cost of +25k to +64k input tokens depending on MCP surface
A tracked .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH negation in .gitignore will make Serena tools resident while keeping operator-local settings files untracked
Per-tool deferral selection is not implementable with current Claude Code controls, so the original <=4-tool acceptance criterion could not be met and was corrected to the global setting approach
The configuration change is reversible via deletion of one JSON key and has no code path impact
